newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Building sets HK$1.0 billion loan.
newsitem.headline: HK Building sets HK$1.0 billion loan.

text.p: Hong Kong Building and Loan Agency has launched a HK$1.0 billion loan facility into general syndication, arranger Schroders Asia said on Monday.
The bullet loan has a tenor of three years. It pays an interest margin of 150 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 52.5 basis points for co-arrangers committing HK$100 million, 30 basis points for senior managers committing HK$50 million and 25 basis points for managers committing HK$30 million.
The deal is secured over residential mortgages in Hong Kong.
The borrower is 41.46 percent held by China Resources (Holdings) Co Ltd.
